_comment: Advisory Stryker mutation scan (tool-scout #3835). COMPARISON-ONLY against the required homegrown gate (src/mutation.ts + scripts/ci/mutation-check.ts) — this file lives in the no-dependency npx lane (ADR-0005): @stryker-mutator/core is invoked through a PINNED `npx --yes -p @stryker-mutator/core@9.6.1` from scripts/ci/stryker-scan.ts, with NO package.json dependency entry (runtime or dev), matching the ast-grep / comby / promptfoo / taze / osv-scanner lane. `mutate` is left EMPTY here on purpose and overridden at runtime via `stryker run --mutate <diff-changed files>` so Stryker only ever mutates the PR's diff-changed src/**/*.ts files (mirroring scripts/ci/mutation-check.ts::filterMutationCandidates, issue #653) — a full-tree run is a regression against #653 and is never acceptable. This config is exercised by the advisory Tier-3 sibling .github/workflows/stryker-check.yml, NEVER by ci.yml, and is NOT a required branch-protection context — a red Stryker run can never block a merge.
